title: Dick Russell's 1994 taped interview with Puharich
summary: Greg Malatzi tells of Dick Russell's 1994 taped interview with Puharich, about 1994 at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I met Puharich once. In fact, I I tape recorded an interview with him. It was '94, literally the year before Puharich died/was found dead mysteriously.

plain: A researcher named Greg Malatzi, on Jesse Michels' podcast in 2026, talks about Andrija Puharich, a scientist the episode describes as a CIA man who claimed contact with an alien council. According to Malatzi, the writer Dick Russell met Puharich once and tape recorded an interview with him in 1994, the year before Puharich died, a death described as mysterious. The tape matters because it would be one of the last records of Puharich speaking for himself.
